title: Reorganize DAG Nodes with Left-to-Right Tree Layout
description: Add reorganize tool with automatic left-to-right Buchheim tree layout, spacing/orientation options, and window engagement chrome for DAG and Flow play apps.
summary: Added DagLayoutOrientation (default leftRight) and DagHost::reorganize with WASM DagSession.reorganize; FlowHost::reorganize overwrites saved widget layout. DagCanvas and FlowCanvas accept reorganize epoch props. DagPlayController and FlowPlayController expose engagement with Reorganize command, orientation toggles, and layer/sibling spacing sliders. Playground surface hosts wire reorganize into canvases.
